ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm (Seashell Blizzard) GPO-driven wiper staging and enterprise fan-out
ucs.description: Hunts the signature GRU Unit 74455 destructive-payload delivery chain — write a wiper binary to a DC's SYSVOL/NETLOGON share, push it enterprise-wide via Group Policy Scheduled Task, then watch it detonate under taskhostw.exe / gpscript.exe on N hosts. This is the exact pattern CERT-UA and Microsoft documented for NotPetya, HermeticWiper, CaddyWiper, IsaacWiper and Industroyer2 staging.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as stage_time values(Filesystem.user) as actor_user values(Filesystem.process_name) as actor_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\NETLOGON\\*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.bat" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ps1" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.dll") AND NOT Filesystem.user="*$" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename dest as staging_host, file_hash as sha256 | join sha256 type=inner [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as exec_time values(Processes.process) as sample_cmd dc(Processes.dest) as fanout_hosts values(Processes.dest) as exec_hosts from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("taskhostw.exe","svchost.exe","gpscript.exe","schtasks.exe") by Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_hash as sha256] | where exec_time >= stage_time AND exec_time <= (stage_time + 21600) AND fanout_hosts >= 3 | table stage_time exec_time staging_host actor_user actor_proc file_name sha256 fanout_hosts exec_hosts sample_cmd | sort - exec_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Staged = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\SYSVOL\", @"\NETLOGON\")
    | where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".bat" or FileName endswith ".ps1" or FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"                            // exclude DFSR/DC replication
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project StageTime=Timestamp, StagingHost=DeviceName, ActorAccount=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ActorProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName, ActorCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              StagedFile=FileName, StagedPath=FolderPath, SHA256;
let FanOut = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("taskhostw.exe","svchost.exe","gpscript.exe","schtasks.exe")  // GPO scheduled-task launch path
    | project ExecTime=Timestamp, ExecHost=DeviceName, ExecFile=FileName, ExecPath=FolderPath,
              ExecCmd=ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
Staged
| join kind=inner FanOut on SHA256
| where ExecTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + 6h)
| summarize FanOutHosts=dcount(ExecHost), FirstExec=min(ExecTime), LastExec=max(ExecTime),
            SampleHosts=make_set(ExecHost, 20), SampleCmd=any(ExecCmd)
            by SHA256, StagedFile, StagingHost, StagedPath, ActorAccount, ActorProcess
| where FanOutHosts >= 3                                                                                  // 3+ host fan-out = GPO push, not one-off admin run
| order by FirstExec desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Staged = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\SYSVOL\", @"\NETLOGON\")
    | where TargetFileExtension in~ ("exe","bat","ps1","dll")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where ActorUsername !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project StageTime=TimeGenerated, StagingHost=DvcHostname, ActorAccount=ActorUsername,
              ActorProcess=ActingProcessName, ActorCmd=ActingProcessCommandLine,
              StagedFile=TargetFileName, StagedPath=TargetFilePath, SHA256=TargetFileSHA256;
let FanOut = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("taskhostw.exe","svchost.exe","gpscript.exe","schtasks.exe")
    | project ExecTime=TimeGenerated, ExecHost=DvcHostname, ExecFile=TargetProcessName,
              ExecCmd=TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
Staged
| join kind=inner FanOut on SHA256
| where ExecTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + 6h)
| summarize FanOutHosts=dcount(ExecHost), FirstExec=min(ExecTime), LastExec=max(ExecTime),
            SampleHosts=make_set(ExecHost, 20), SampleCmd=any(ExecCmd)
            by SHA256, StagedFile, StagingHost, StagedPath, ActorAccount, ActorProcess
| where FanOutHosts >= 3
| order by FirstExec desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:*\\SYSVOL\\* OR @TargetFilename:*\\sysvol\\* OR @TargetFilename:*\\NETLOGON\\* OR @TargetFilename:*\\netlogon\\*) (@TargetFilename:*.exe OR @TargetFilename:*.EXE OR @TargetFilename:*.bat OR @TargetFilename:*.BAT OR @TargetFilename:*.ps1 OR @TargetFilename:*.PS1 OR @TargetFilename:*.dll OR @TargetFilename:*.DLL) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\(SYSVOL|NETLOGON)\\.*\.(exe|bat|ps1|dll)$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([SHA256HashData, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, UserName], function=[count(as=writes), collect([aid, ComputerName], multival=true)])
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(taskhostw|svchost|gpscript|schtasks)\.exe$/i | groupBy([SHA256HashData], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=fanout_hosts), collect([ComputerName], multival=true, as=exec_hosts)])}, field=SHA256HashData, include=[fanout_hosts, exec_hosts])
| fanout_hosts >= 3
ucs.rationale: Sandworm has used GPO-mediated payload deployment as its enterprise-wipe primitive across NotPetya (2017), HermeticWiper/IsaacWiper (Feb 2022), CaddyWiper (Mar 2022), Industroyer2 (Apr 2022), and CERT-UA's 2023 Prestige campaigns. The signature is a stolen domain-admin token writing a payload to a DC's SYSVOL/NETLOGON share and creating a GPO Scheduled Task that detonates it under taskhostw/gpscri

ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm HermeticWiper / IsaacWiper driver-abuse — EaseUS partition-manager driver dropped & service-installed
ucs.description: Hunts the Voodoo Bear wiper signature of dropping a legitimately-signed third-party storage driver (EaseUS empntdrv.sys / DRV_X64 / DRV_X86 — also seen as 4-8 char random .sys names) into %TEMP%/%ProgramData% then immediately registering it as a Windows service so the wiper can perform raw-disk writes from user mode. This sequence is the load-bearing primitive of HermeticWiper, IsaacWiper, AcidRain and CaddyWiper variants used against Ukrainian targets and the Viasat KA-SAT modems.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as drop_time values(Filesystem.process_name) as drop_proc values(Filesystem.user) as drop_user values(Filesystem.file_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*") AND NOT Filesystem.user="*$" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join dest type=inner [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as install_time values(Registry.registry_value_data) as service_image values(Registry.registry_path) as service_key values(Registry.process_name) as reg_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*" AND Registry.registry_value_name="ImagePath" AND Registry.registry_value_data="*.sys" by Registry.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)`] | where install_time >= drop_time AND install_time <= (drop_time + 600) | eval driver_in_svc=if(like(service_image, "%".file_name."%"), 1, 0) | where driver_in_svc=1 | eval suspicious_name=if(match(file_name,"(?i)^[a-z0-9]{1,8}\.sys$") OR match(file_name,"(?i)^(epmntdrv|empntdrv|DRV_X64|DRV_X86|RwDrv|partmgr)\.sys$"), 1, 0) | where suspicious_name=1 | table drop_time install_time dest file_name file_path sha256 drop_proc drop_user service_key service_image reg_proc | sort - drop_time
ucs.kql:
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\",
                                 @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DropTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, DriverFile=FileName, DriverPath=FolderPath,
              SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let ServiceInstall = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has @"\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData endswith ".sys"
    | project InstallTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, ServiceKey=RegistryKey,
              ServiceImage=RegistryValueData,
              RegProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RegAccount=InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner ServiceInstall on DeviceName
| where InstallTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 10m)
| where ServiceImage has DriverFile
| where DriverFile matches regex @"(?i)^[a-z0-9]{1,8}\.sys$"                                          // short random name = HermeticWiper/CaddyWiper pattern
    or DriverFile in~ ("epmntdrv.sys","empntdrv.sys","DRV_X64.sys","DRV_X86.sys","RwDrv.sys","partmgr.sys")  // EaseUS / known wiper sidecar drivers
| project DropTime, InstallTime, DeviceName, DriverFile, DriverPath, SHA256, ServiceKey, ServiceImage,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName, RegProcess
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let DriverDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileExtension =~ "sys"
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\",
                                     @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project DropTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DriverFile=TargetFileName, DriverPath=TargetFilePath,
              SHA256=TargetFileSHA256, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername;
let ServiceInstall = ImRegistryEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has @"\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValue =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData endswith ".sys"
    | project InstallTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ServiceKey=RegistryKey,
              ServiceImage=RegistryValueData, RegProcess=ActingProcessName, RegAccount=ActorUsername;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner ServiceInstall on DvcHostname
| where InstallTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 10m)
| where ServiceImage has DriverFile
| where DriverFile matches regex @"(?i)^[a-z0-9]{1,8}\.sys$"
    or DriverFile in~ ("epmntdrv.sys","empntdrv.sys","DRV_X64.sys","DRV_X86.sys","RwDrv.sys")
| project DropTime, InstallTime, DvcHostname, DriverFile, DriverPath, SHA256, ServiceKey, ServiceImage,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername, RegProcess
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon ((@EventID:13 AND (@TargetObject:*\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*\\ImagePath OR @TargetObject:*\\system\\currentcontrolset\\services\\*\\imagepath) AND (@Details:*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*.sys OR @Details:*\\ProgramData\\*.sys OR @Details:*\\Users\\Public\\*.sys OR @Details:*\\Windows\\Temp\\*.sys)) OR (@EventID:13 AND (@Details:*\\epmntdrv.sys OR @Details:*\\empntdrv.sys OR @Details:*\\DRV_X64.sys OR @Details:*\\DRV_X86.sys OR @Details:*\\RwDrv.sys))) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
| RegObjectName=/\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\.+/i
| RegValueName=/^ImagePath$/i
| RegStringValue=/\\(AppData\\Local\\Temp|ProgramData|Users\\Public|Windows\\Temp)\\.+\.sys$/i
| OR { RegStringValue=/\\(epmntdrv|empntdrv|DRV_X64|DRV_X86|RwDrv)\.sys$/i RegStringValue=/\\[a-z0-9]{1,8}\.sys$/i }
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\.sys$/i TargetFileName=/\\(AppData\\Local\\Temp|ProgramData|Users\\Public|Windows\\Temp)\\/i}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName, SHA256HashData, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, SHA256HashData, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName, UserName], function=[min(@timestamp, as=first_seen)])
ucs.rationale: Sandworm wipers (HermeticWiper aka FoxBlade, IsaacWiper aka Lasainraw, CaddyWiper, AcidRain) all rely on the same primitive: drop a benign-signed third-party storage driver — most famously EaseUS's empntdrv.sys/DRV_X64.sys signed by 'CHENGDU YIWO Tech Development' — into a user-writable folder and register it as a Windows service so the wiper can call DeviceIoControl to perform raw partition write
